docs.doc: Story acceptance criteria and technical notes. Checkpoint table schema: sync_checkpoint (user_id, phase, last_entity_id, processed_count, timestamp). Checkpoint frequency: configurable (default: every 100 entities or every phase completion). Atomic checkpoint save: database transaction. Resume logic: load checkpoint, skip already-processed entities.

Import flow architecture and checkpoint system. Progress tracking should resume from checkpoint position, not from zero. Calculate progress as: (checkpoint_progress + new_progress) / total. Restore phase progress map from checkpoint. Checkpoint storage in ImportCheckpoint table (id='current').

ImportCheckpoint model structure: id (String @id @default('current')), currentPhase (String), currentBatch (Int), lastProcessedId (String?), processedIds (String[]), progress (Int), isPaused (Boolean @default(false)), timestamps.
TanStack Query for server state (resume API calls). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts. Use hooks for API calls and state management.
Use ShadCN/UI components: Dialog for resume modal, Button for actions, Card for checkpoint information display. Components located in src/components/ui/.
Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Ensure resume dialog works on all screen sizes.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text. Ensure resume dialog is fully accessible.
Handle checkpoint errors gracefully: invalid checkpoint, missing checkpoint, corrupted checkpoint. Provide user-friendly error messages.

ImportOrchestrator has comprehensive progress tracking with phase progress, current entity tracking, and processing rate calculation. Checkpoint system should integrate with this progress tracking. ImportStartTime tracking for elapsed time calculation. Phase progress Map tracks processed/total counts per phase.

constraint.rule: Checkpoint storage uses ImportCheckpoint table (id='current'). Use atomic database transaction for checkpoint saves. CheckpointManager class handles save/load/clear operations.
Checkpoint frequency: configurable (default: every 100 entities or every phase completion). Balance between checkpoint overhead and resume granularity.
Resume logic: Load checkpoint, restore phase and batch position, skip already-processed entities using processedIds, continue from lastProcessedId. Restore phase progress map and import start time.
Progress tracking should resume from checkpoint position, not from zero. Calculate progress as: (checkpoint_progress + new_progress) / total. Restore phase progress map from checkpoint.
Use TanStack Query for server state (resume API calls). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts.
Use ShadCN/UI components: Dialog for resume modal, Button for actions, Card for checkpoint information display.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.
Handle checkpoint errors gracefully: invalid checkpoint, missing checkpoint, corrupted checkpoint. Provide user-friendly error messages.
Test coverage minimum 80%. Write tests before implementation (TDD). Include unit, integration, and E2E tests.
Test complete flow: save checkpoint → interrupt import → detect checkpoint → resume → verify progress. Test checkpoint data integrity, stale checkpoint detection, progress resume accuracy.

interface.name: CheckpointManager API
interface.signature: class CheckpointManager { async saveCheckpoint(checkpoint: ImportCheckpoint): Promise<void>; async loadCheckpoint(): Promise<ImportCheckpoint | null>; async clearCheckpoint(): Promise<void>; }

interface.name: ImportCheckpoint Interface
interface.signature: interface ImportCheckpoint { currentPhase: ImportPhase; currentBatch: number; lastProcessedId: string | null; processedIds: string[]; progress: number; isPaused?: boolean; }

interface.name: Resume Import API
interface.signature: POST /api/gomafia-sync/import/resume - Request: {} | Response: { success: boolean; message: string; checkpoint?: { phase: string; batch: number; progress: number; } }

interface.name: ImportOrchestrator Methods
interface.signature: class ImportOrchestrator { async saveCheckpoint(checkpoint: ImportCheckpoint): Promise<void>; async loadCheckpoint(): Promise<ImportCheckpoint | null>; async start(): Promise<string>; async resumeFromCheckpoint(): Promise<void>; // TO BE IMPLEMENTED }

tests.standards: Testing standards require minimum 80% coverage, TDD approach. Unit tests for checkpoint save/load operations, integration tests for resume flow, E2E tests for user-facing resume dialog. Use Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E tests. Test complete flow: save checkpoint → interrupt import → detect checkpoint → resume → verify progress. Test checkpoint data integrity, stale checkpoint detection (24 hours), progress resume accuracy. Use @axe-core/playwright for E2E accessibility testing to verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
